scope: Stage A slice: one action vocabulary and effective action resolution, export authorization, frontend capability verdicts for navigation and export/write controls

server.authz: internal/authz owns action names, canonical order, role defaults and whitelist resolution
server.effective_actions: The snapshot user carries the resolved actions array; explicit whitelist overrides role defaults and admin receives all actions
server.history_export: Product and EMS history exports require the export action; refusal returns export_required before any CSV header
server.profile_csv: EMS profile points.csv requires the export action
server.ems_access: EMS API consumes the same resolved action set; legacy boolean fields remain only as an adapter for trusted internal callers
server.route_table: internal/authz declares every authenticated product and EMS route with its required action and stable refusal code; each HTTP entry applies the declaration once; unknown dynamic operations retain handler 404 behavior and unresolved impact bodies fail closed
server.channel_configuration: ChannelAdmin relies on the route action instead of a second Admin-only check; the alarm configuration boundary runs only after authorization

frontend.capability: frontend/src/capabilities.ts computes allowed/refused with action grant, disabled, read-only and server availability reasons
frontend.context: frontend/src/capabilitiesContext.tsx lets pages consume one verdict without prop drilling
frontend.navigation: Page definitions declare requiredAction; delivery availability follows any visible delivery page rather than role strings
frontend.exports: History, alarms, point-table, profile verification, Modbus CSV, profile points and evidence exports are hidden without the export action
frontend.writes: Screen disables writes on stopped points with a visible reason; point detail blocks write and manual takeover for disabled/read-only points

verification.route_matrix: Real HTTP covers configure-only channel creation, delete-only channel deletion, denied delete without configuration side effects, frames, alarm acknowledgement/close/maintenance/release; direct EMS HTTP covers the same action set
verification.action_role_matrix: Real HTTP with real identities covers every one of the 14 actions against admin, implementer, operator and viewer role defaults; project read routes retain configure and oversized unresolved impact previews fail closed for non-admin callers
verification.browser: Real debug backend + own dev server: viewer and operator have no workbench and no history export; an export-only viewer has the export button but no workbench; implementer has both workbenches and export; API viewer history export is 403 while the explicit export grant passes authorization

remaining_stage_a: Declare route scope-target resolvers in the shared table; object scope is still enforced by the owning handlers
Complete target-state reasons across remaining command/config controls
Deduplicate the schedule polling and freshness work is Stage B, not this slice
limits: No production device connection or physical write
No behavior change to role defaults beyond honoring an explicit action whitelist
Local debug accounts only; no credentials in evidence
